Commit 74d0048 was created and pushed at the user's explicit request at a completed-implementation but pending-review boundary. Riela did not reach terminal acceptance.

SUPERSEDED in session 57: the earlier note that no Riela review step had completed in any session was true only through Step 6. Session 57 subsequently completed the self-review, the test-integrity check, the ordinary review, and the adversarial gate, which accepted at comm-000771.
The verification totals above come from session 57's direct mise run build, mise run lint, and mise run check, not from a Riela review gate.
The completion percentage stays below 100 because commit generation has not run and the ownership-witness re-verification entry stays open on the partially met D8.

The fifth remainingGates entry, re-verify the ownership-witness descendant-liveness remediation under review, was initially removed on the basis that D1 through D9 were all complete. That basis was withdrawn in the same session once D8 was reduced to partial by the Linux build finding, and the entry was RESTORED with its open deliverable named. It is not a fifth review gate; it tracks the remediation itself.

RETRACTED in session 57: the claim that the Linux branch is compiled by .github/workflows/linux-amd64-build.yml is false. That job has failed on every recent push to main, including run 33371669137 on the base commit 74d0048, at 'sqlite3.h' file not found before any Swift source is compiled. ai-agent-integration.md has been corrected in place. The Linux build break was reported, not fixed: all its causes are outside this issue's scope.

Follow-up warranted and NOT done here: add libsqlite3-dev to the Linux workflow, unwrap the two posix_spawn baseAddress arguments at AgentGatewayCLIInvoker.swift:526 and :634, and split the NoteService+TagDetail.swift:113 expression. Until those land, no claim that any Linux code path in this repository compiles should be drawn from CI.

The Linux enumeration fix is established by construction and unit-level reasoning and was not executed on Linux. Its whole-product compilability is NOT mechanically established either, because the Linux build is broken upstream (see the RETRACTED note above). The only mechanical Linux evidence is swiftc -typecheck of AgentGatewayProcessTermination.swift alone, which covers symbol and type resolution and nothing about behavior.
Riela's authoritative runtime state is stored outside the repository under its session store.

The default kaiba note root at the user's home directory is schema version 10 while the current kaiba requires 17, and kaiba carries no migrations, so the prior knowledge base is unreadable by the current binary.

All three are fixed above.

Session 57 revision after comm-000766: the ESRCH residual that Step 6, the self-review, and the ordinary review all accepted as a negligible microsecond window measured at 1.56% of enumerations per probe under churn, and scheduleFinalGroupCleanup takes exactly one probe. Three successive gates reasoned about the window instead of measuring it; the adversarial gate measured it. Recorded because the failure mode was analytical, not mechanical.
